thesis: A net-cash, very high-return footwear brand owner with flat margins and ROCE at its 2-year high trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 10.12% FCF yield, pricing a revenue decline its slowed-but-positive outlook does not show.
reason: Same evidence as the 2026-11-15 HOLD: margins intact, ROIC dip explained by capital build, multiples below their 5y floor. The guidance cut and discounting cap conviction at the hold level; cash sits near the 1.5% floor (owner rule: residual cash), so there is no room to add without a swap. Keep the current size.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the FY2024 level of 55.6%, showing rival discounting or markdowns are eroding full-price discipline.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 14%, showing working capital or margin stress rather than a seasonal swing.
TTM ROIC falls below 55%, showing the decline from 72.7% is no longer capital build but eroding returns.
